content: परिष्टो(स्तो)मः .²1 The coloured housings of an elephant. .²2 A coverlet in general. .²3 A cushion.

परिस्तोमः .²1 A painted or variegated cloth for a cover on elephantʼs back (कुथ); द्रुमाणां विविधैः पुष्पैः परिस्तोमैरिवार्पितम् <ls>Rām. 4. 1. 8</ls>; <ls>Mb. 6. 54. 54</ls>. .²2 A sacrificial vessel; <ls>Mb. 5. 141. 41</ls>. (<ab>com.</ab> परिस्तोमाः सोमचमसादयः).
